attr.title: Fire & Brimstone
attr.desc:
Delve into the ruins of a temple in the guts of a volcano, in the search for a powerful artefact that may let you have friends.
A unique and tight roguelike with a randomized skilltree and hand-designed monsters and items.
attr.inst: Download the MacOS version from Itch.io and extract the game files into gamedata folder.
attr.inst_md: Download the `MacOS version`  from [Itch.io](https://punkcake.itch.io/brimstone) and extract the game files into `gamedata` folder.
